facts.text: Audrey and her friends went on a hike and discovered a stunning lake in the mountains.

evidence.quote: So a few years back my friends and I went on a hike and stumbled across this stunning lake in the mountains.

facts.text: Audrey and her friends sat by the lake, chatting and admiring the peacefulness of nature.

evidence.quote: We sat by it, chat and admiring the peacefulness of nature.

facts.text: Audrey found the experience of being by the lake to be calming and rejuvenating.

evidence.quote: It really was! Nature and the lake were so calming, exactly what I needed.

facts.text: Andrew expressed admiration for the peacefulness of the lake and the experience Audrey described.

evidence.quote: Wow, that looks so peaceful. It must have been a great spot!
Sounds like you had a really peaceful and calming experience! Glad you got to appreciate the beauty of life.
